derivation: The restarted payment permit and its replay copy omit the first of the two prior-effect bases required by pay-invoice. The permit identifier, the proposal record and receipt that name it, and the last receipt and replay are all recomputed over the changed bytes, so every commitment in the checkpoint is internally consistent and the incomplete required basis set is the only defect. LIFE-008 makes the prior-effect basis a retained binding, and LIFE-019 requires each permit to carry exactly the prior-effect bases its active step required at proposal time and recomputes that on restart. The consumer returns STATE_INVALID before evaluating the clock event.
